rows.message: OrderPanelComponent.cancel branches on 410 from POST /orders/:param/cancel, which never answers 410: it answers 404, 409
rows.evidence: every failure of the route was read with its status and nothing behind it left unread; statuses a proxy or the framework may answer (400, 401, 403, 408, 413, 429, 5xx) are not judged
rows.fix: branch on what the route answers (404, 409), or make it answer 410

config-not-set.why: the configuration module in src/app.module.ts validates the settings with a schema, which may give it a default

status-never-answered.why: POST /orders/:param/refund throws HttpException, whose status is not read
